test_title: PYST 07: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: While covering a distance of 54 km, a man noticed that after cycling for 1 hour 15 minutes, the distance covered by him was (7)/(9) of the remaining distance. What was his speed (in km/hr)?
solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 54 km

Time = 1 hr 15 min = 1.25 hr

Distance covered = (7)/(9) of the remaining distance

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

Let distance covered = x km

Then remaining distance = 54 - x

x = (7/9) × (54 - x)

⇒ 9x = 7(54 - x)

⇒ 9x = 378 - 7x

⇒ 9x + 7x = 378

⇒ 16x = 378

⇒ x = 378 ÷ 16 = 23.625 km

Speed = 23.625 ÷ 1.25 = 18.9 km/hr

**∴ The man's speed is 18.9 km/hr.**
